testcase.name: re-selecting an unset field's own default is not dirty()
editing a number to a new value is dirty and writes a numeric Set()
onSaved after a clear marks the field unset and shows the default()
an enum value outside the declared set is a validation error()
an unset field edited to a value is dirty (was using the default)()
a non-numeric number edit is a validation error and is excluded from writes()
an empty string is a valid string value()
a dotted path maps to literal segments (lc1)()
a set-but-null value displays the default (not a blank or false control)()
reset-to-default clears a set key but is a no-op on an unset key()
a fresh model is not modified and has nothing to write()
re-typing the same integral number (Gson Double baseline) is not dirty()
onSaved advances the baseline so the field is no longer dirty()
